verdict.rationale: Each skill lives as a plain `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` file in an open GitHub repo (docs-4, docs-14, docs-16). The same repo installs through the open `skills` CLI into Claude Code, Codex and Pi (gh-1, gh-2), and ships portable Hermes/Agent Plugins plus Cursor metadata as JSON (gh-5), so the format is readable, copyable text rather than a proprietary binary. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that skills can be copied by hand without the CLI, independent hands-on corroboration of moving skills to another harness, and evidence on how the skills' reliance on the `yy` CLI/Ledger tooling affects real portability.
